get.summary: Customer dashboard KPI baseline aggregate (D02-ASM-001, CUST-04, CUST-05, CUST-06)
get.description: Non-blocking customer dashboard KPI baseline derived from linked mock records: outstanding balance = issued invoice total minus approved allocations; credit utilisation = outstanding balance ÷ mock credit limit; vehicle counts use canonical vehicle IDs and current server status. Server-authoritative; no browser calculation or fabrication. Requires authentication.

200.description: Customer dashboard aggregate with KPI values

get.summary: List customer transaction fleet vehicles (CUST-02, CUST-10, RULE-04, RULE-08)
get.description: Returns list of vehicles associated with the authenticated customer across all transaction lifecycle stages (Under Negotiation, Under Negotiation With PI, Confirmed, In Transit, Delivered). Strict customer scoping; vehicles appear once with server-authoritative status and linked document references. Requires authentication.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by canonical vehicle transaction status

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search keyword matching make, model, chassis number, or year

200.description: List of customer fleet vehicles with aggregate counts

get.summary: Get customer vehicle detail and full transaction timeline (CUST-11, CUST-12, CUST-13, RULE-04)
get.description: Returns full customer detail for a specific transaction vehicle, including technical specifications, status timeline history, deposit requirement (30% under RULE-07), invoice, shipment progress, and linked export documents. Scoped strictly to authenticated customer. Requires authentication.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Vehicle ID, slug, or transaction reference

200.description: Customer vehicle detail with status timeline and linked documents

404.description: Vehicle not found or not owned by customer

get.summary: List customer invoices and proforma invoices (CUST-02, CUST-14, CUST-15, RULE-04, RULE-08, RULE-10)
get.description: Returns list of issued Proforma Invoices (PI) and approved Commercial Invoices belonging to the authenticated customer. Strictly scoped by customer identity with server-calculated paid/outstanding totals, 72h payment deadlines for PIs, and linked document availability. Requires authentication.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search text matching invoice number, vehicle make, model, chassis, or year

200.description: List of customer invoices and proforma invoices with aggregate counts and totals

get.summary: Get customer invoice or proforma invoice detail (CUST-14, CUST-15, CUST-16, CUST-21, RULE-04, RULE-07)
get.description: Returns full details for a specific customer invoice or proforma invoice, including line items, vehicle specifications, approved payment allocations, official bank account details for wire transfer, and document availability. Scoped strictly to authenticated customer. Requires authentication.

BearerAuth.description: Customer or staff JWT returned by the authentication endpoint.

tierDescriptions.description: Customer inventory pricing descriptions keyed by customer tier.

liveAuctionUrl.description: Approved external Live Auction destination (PUB-27, D01-ASM-002). Absent when no destination is approved — the account-gated Live Auction entry is hidden, never a placeholder link (RULE-10).

SessionClaims.description: Stand-in demo JWT claims (DEC-PUB-AUTH-BOUNDARY). Never a production identity.

CustomerAccount.description: Registered customer account projection. Never carries a password, hash or salt (Phase 2.12, CUST-26).

password.description: Minimum 12 characters, at least one letter and one digit (D02-ASM-005). Never echoed back.

message.example: If an account exists for that email, a password reset token has been issued to the mock outbox.

PasswordResetOutboxEntry.description: Non-production-only mock outbox entry. Never contains a password, hash or salt.

limit.description: Maximum number of favourites allowed per customer (CUST-40)

FavouriteSearchFacets.description: Distinct values available for each favourite field, populated from real vehicle data (D02-P13-T002, CUST-39, D02-ASM-008). The four fields without backing columns (modelCodes, engineCcOptions, colors, steeringOptions) return empty arrays.

modelCodes.description: D02-ASM-008: no backing column; always empty

engineCcOptions.description: D02-ASM-008: no backing column; always empty

colors.description: D02-ASM-008: no backing column; always empty

steeringOptions.description: D02-ASM-008: no backing column; always empty

ReservationRequest.description: PUB-23, RULE-05, D01-P06-T004: a transactional 48-hour reservation hold request for the authenticated demo customer.

ReservationResponse.description: A persisted reservation hold. `status` is always computed live from `expiresAt` versus the current instant — DEC-PUB-RESERVATION-EXPIRY-ACTION is OPEN, so no automatic release action is ever claimed to have occurred (RULE-10).

CustomerDashboard.description: Customer dashboard aggregate with linked record KPIs (D02-ASM-001, D02-P02-T001). Outstanding balance = issued invoice total - approved allocations. Credit utilisation = outstanding balance ÷ credit limit. Vehicle counts use canonical IDs and server status. Payment/shipment/document/notification summaries computed from linked records. Freshness metadata and partial failure indicators included. Server-derived; no browser calculation.
